definitions.explanation: A bath or bathing facility, especially hot springs.

examples.japanese: {湯|ゆ}を{沸|わ}かしてください。

examples.english: The hot water is too hot.

notes:
{湯|ゆ} means hot water or bath.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- お{湯|ゆ}: hot water (polite)
- {湯|ゆ}{気|げ}: steam
- {湯|ゆ}のみ: teacup
- {温泉|おんせん}: hot spring
- {銭湯|せんとう}: public bath

COMMON VERBS:
- {湯|ゆ}を{沸|わ}かす: to boil water
- {湯|ゆ}に{入|はい}る: to take a bath

Note: {水|みず} is cold/room-temperature water; {湯|ゆ} is specifically heated water.
